{"path":"snake_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript classic Snake game. Requirements:

GAMEPLAY / BOARD
- 30x30 grid board rendered on a <canvas> (cell size ~20px, canvas 600x600, responsive scaling with CSS max-width).
- Snake(s) move continuously on a fixed tick interval (e.g. 110ms), one cell per tick, in one of four directions.
- Eating food grows the snake by 1 segment and increases the score.
- Collision with a wall (out of bounds) or with the snake's own body ends the game for that snake.
- Food is placed randomly on free cells.

GAME MODES (selectable from the start menu)
1. "Human vs Human" — two snakes, both keyboard-controlled (P1: WASD, P2: Arrow keys).
2. "CPU vs Human" — snake 1 is CPU-controlled, snake 2 is keyboard-controlled (arrow keys).
3. "CPU vs CPU" — both snakes CPU-controlled.
In single-snake contexts still keep two snakes for consistency; each snake has its own score.

CPU AI
- CPU snake automatically searches for food: BFS/A* shortest path on the 30x30 grid avoiding walls, its own body and the opponent's body; fall back to a safe-direction heuristic (prefer moves that keep most free space / avoid immediate death) when no path exists.
- CPU must never reverse directly into itself.

UI
- Start menu overlay with title, mode buttons, controls legend, and difficulty/speed selector.
- HUD during gameplay showing both snakes' scores (and which is CPU/Human), plus current mode.
- Game over screen overlay showing the winner and final scores, with a "Press R (or Space/Enter) to restart" hint and a button.
- Restart with a keypress (R, and also Space/Enter) returns to gameplay in the same mode; Esc returns to the start menu.
- Pause with P.

STYLE
- Dark, modern arcade look: dark background, neon-green snake 1, cyan/orange snake 2, red food, subtle glow, grid lines, rounded cells, monospace font.
- Clean, well-structured code with comments; no external libraries, no external assets.

Everything in ONE file named snake_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html."}

p = "snake_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html"

# syntax check with node
